question.problem: There are $11$ people taking an online quiz at the same time. How many ways can people finish in first, second, and third place, assuming there are no ties?
question.worked_solution:
The number of permutations of $n$ objects taken $r$ at a time is given by the formula

$$
{}_{n}{P}_{r}=\frac{n!}{(n-r)!}.
$$

There are $11$ people, so $n=11.$ We want to select $3$ of those people to come first, second, or third, so we have $r=3.$

Therefore, the number of different ways to place the people is

$$
\begin{aligned}{}_{11}{P}_{3} & =\frac{11!}{(11-3)!} \\  & =\frac{11!}{8!} \\  & =\frac{11\cdot 10\cdot 9\cdot \cancel{8!}}{\cancel{8!}} \\  & =11\cdot 10\cdot 9 \\  & =990.\end{aligned}
$$
